mapper.sql: SELECT n.*, c.code AS customer_code, c.name AS customer_name, s.code AS supplier_code, s.name AS supplier_name, v.voucher_no, u.nickname AS create_by_name FROM fin_netting n LEFT JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = n.customer_id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier s ON s.id = n.supplier_id LEFT JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = n.voucher_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = n.create_by
mapper.select: SELECT i.*, b.bill_no, b.bill_date, b.source_type, b.source_no, b.amount AS bill_amount FROM fin_netting_item i JOIN fin_bill b ON b.id = i.bill_id WHERE i.netting_id = #{nettingId} ORDER BY i.kind DESC, i.id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO fin_netting_item (netting_id, bill_id, kind, amount, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{i.nettingId}, #{i.billId}, #{i.kind}, #{i.amount}, NOW(), NOW())
